shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surpasses $75K, fueled by Treasury bond buybacks & US crypto policy hopes.
Spot Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs see strong inflows, indicating institutional buying.
XRP surges past $1.40, driven by significant whale and ETF accumulation.
US pushes Clarity Act for crypto, SEC proposes new offering rules.
Rising oil prices from geopolitical tensions (Iran) weigh on broader markets, but crypto decouples.
